summary: Pony AI Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its September 2026 monthly return to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong (equivalent to a routine US current report on Form 8-K). The exhibit confirms no change in authorized share capital at USD 300,000.01 across Class A and Class B weighted-voting ordinary shares; issued Class A shares rose 770,545 to 354,095,390, while Class B stayed at 81,088,770, driven by share-option exercises. The company also confirmed compliance with its 10% minimum public-float requirement. No special-situation event arises.
